adversarial: Read scope.json first, then read and follow every file in scope.instruction_files.

The reviewed finding location must stay inside scope.repository_path. Supporting evidence and reachability steps may use an absolute current-side path inside a Git repository explicitly listed in scope.evidence_repositories; relative paths always resolve inside the reviewed repository. For other external material, use a concrete reference with location null rather than an undeclared filesystem path.
Complete the adversarial lane '{lane}' in one pass by directly inspecting repository source, reachable callers, relevant tests, and applicable contracts.

Write every human-facing string in scope.output_language, including finding titles, context, triggers, impacts, manifestation text, evidence statements, recommendations, and coverage notes. Keep code symbols, paths, commands, and fixed JSON enum values unchanged. Use plain, intuitive wording that a person unfamiliar with the code path can understand without translating internal shorthand.
Stay within scope.target, scope.topic, and scope.exclusions. Report only discrete actionable defects meeting scope.finding_standard; write an empty candidates list when none qualify.

Do not emit candidates for dead or unreachable code, test-only paths outside scope, unsupported configurations, states blocked by existing guards, completed one-time migrations, speculative risks, or low-impact issues whose fix cost or maintenance burden outweighs their value. Treat access limitations as coverage gaps rather than manufacturing a finding.

For every candidate, write an intuitive manifestation with a concrete setup, ordered user/system steps, and the exact observable failure. Use verified_reproduction only when directly exercised and supported by verified test or command evidence; otherwise use reasoned_scenario. Do not paraphrase trigger or impact as the steps, and do not use placeholders such as 'the issue occurs'.

Record exact repository paths and tight line ranges. For a change review, use finding.location for the changed range that introduces the trigger, state, call, contract, configuration, or deletion; put unchanged code where the failure manifests in supporting evidence. Use location.side new for added or current lines and old for deletion-only lines from scope.comparison_base; cross-repository locations must be absolute and use side new. Every evidence item needs a concrete reference; caller and contract evidence used to qualify a finding also needs a source location in the reviewed repository or a declared evidence repository. Separate verified evidence from inference. Do not run checks that write any repository or remote service.

Write only the fixed #/$defs/adversarial JSON artifact to output_path. Before sending the receipt, execute the packet's validation_command argv exactly. Do not modify repository files, do not delegate, and reveal no finding content in the receipt.
dedup: Read scope.json first, then read and follow every file in scope.instruction_files.
Read every adversarial artifact in input_paths and cover every raw ID in assigned_ids exactly once.
Write merge_basis and any other human-readable prose in scope.output_language. Keep code symbols, paths, identifiers, and fixed JSON enum values unchanged.

Merge candidates only when root cause, trigger, manifestation, impact, and remedy are materially the same. Preserve the clearest accurate setup, ordered steps, failure result, and causal primary location; keep unchanged failure sites in supporting evidence. Do not decide validity and do not drop doubtful unique candidates.
Assign unique stable F### IDs, preserve a complete non-overlapping source_candidate_ids mapping, and provide a non-empty merge_basis.

Write only the fixed #/$defs/dedup JSON artifact to output_path. Before sending the receipt, execute the packet's validation_command argv exactly. Work read-only, do not delegate, and reveal no finding content in the receipt.
refutation: Read scope.json first, then read and follow every file in scope.instruction_files.

The reviewed finding location must stay inside scope.repository_path. Supporting evidence and reachability steps may use an absolute current-side path inside a Git repository explicitly listed in scope.evidence_repositories; relative paths always resolve inside the reviewed repository. For other external material, use a concrete reference with location null rather than an undeclared filesystem path.
Read the dedup artifact in input_paths and evaluate every canonical ID in assigned_ids exactly once. Continue through all assigned IDs after finding a defect; do not stop early.

Write all analysis, evidence statements, uncertainty, and replacement finding prose in scope.output_language. Keep code symbols, paths, commands, and fixed JSON enum values unchanged. Make explanations intuitive to a person unfamiliar with the call path.

Directly inspect the complete scoped diff or topic surface plus enough surrounding source, reachable callers, contracts, tests, and history to decide each candidate independently. For a change review, confirm that the defect was introduced by the merge-relevant diff and that the primary range identifies its changed cause and overlaps that diff; keep unchanged code where the failure manifests in supporting evidence. For a topic review, confirm that it falls inside the named scope.

Fill qualification from direct evidence. Qualify only when production_reachable, inside_authorized_scope, material_impact, and likely_author_would_fix_now are yes; fix_value is positive; introduced_by_change is yes for change review or not_applicable for topic review; and reachability_path is an ordered set of concrete source location plus code-symbol reference steps. Any disqualifying no or negative requires refute. Any remaining unknown or unclear requires unresolved.

An uphold or modify result must include verified caller, test, command, or contract evidence establishing reachability. Give every evidence item a concrete reference: a code symbol or contract name for caller/contract evidence, a test identifier for test evidence, or the executed command for command evidence. Caller and contract evidence also needs a source location. Refute speculative concerns, pre-existing problems, intentional behavior changes, style nits, dead or test-only paths outside scope, guard-blocked states, completed migrations, and fixes whose cost exceeds their operational value.

Check reachability, scope, intent, the accuracy and verification status of the manifestation steps, persistent or operational impact, applicable convergence requirements, and recommendation proportionality. Inspect relevant tests and call sites rather than accepting the original candidate's evidence at face value.

Actively challenge nitpicking findings and over-defensive remedies. Weigh realistic probability, impact, affected users, and duration against implementation complexity, new failure modes, and long-term maintenance debt. If an extremely unlikely, low-impact finding would require extra state, compatibility layers, broad retries, repair or migration logic, or other disproportionate machinery, prefer refute. If the underlying defect is real but the proposed remedy is too broad, use modify with the smallest proportionate recommendation. Do not dismiss irreversible data loss or security impact solely because its probability is low.
Use verdict uphold, modify, refute, or unresolved. A modify result must include a complete same-ID replacement_finding; all other results must use null.

Write only the fixed #/$defs/refutation JSON artifact to output_path. Before sending the receipt, execute the packet's validation_command argv exactly. Work read-only, do not delegate, and reveal no finding content in the receipt.
judgment: Read scope.json first, then read and follow every file in scope.instruction_files.

The reviewed finding location must stay inside scope.repository_path. Supporting evidence and reachability steps may use an absolute current-side path inside a Git repository explicitly listed in scope.evidence_repositories; relative paths always resolve inside the reviewed repository. For other external material, use a concrete reference with location null rather than an undeclared filesystem path.

Read the dedup and refutation artifacts in input_paths and issue one fresh binding result for every canonical ID in assigned_ids exactly once, including candidates the refuter upheld. Continue through all assigned IDs after resolving one; do not stop early.

Write all resolved points, evidence statements, residual risk, and final finding prose in scope.output_language. Keep code symbols, paths, commands, and fixed JSON enum values unchanged. Make the decision understandable to a person unfamiliar with the call path.

Decide independently from direct inspection of the complete scoped diff or topic surface plus enough surrounding source, reachable callers, contracts, tests, and history. For a change review, confirm that the defect was introduced by the merge-relevant diff and that the primary range identifies its changed cause and overlaps that diff; keep unchanged code where the failure manifests in supporting evidence. For a topic review, confirm that it falls inside the named scope.

Fill qualification independently from direct evidence, using ordered source location plus code-symbol reference steps for reachability_path. Uphold or modify only when every qualification gate passes; reject when any gate is disqualifying; use unresolved when no gate is disqualifying but any gate remains unknown or unclear. An uphold or modify result must include verified caller, test, command, or contract evidence establishing reachability. Give every evidence item a concrete code symbol, contract name, test identifier, or executed command reference; caller and contract evidence also needs a source location.

Reject speculative concerns, pre-existing problems, intentional behavior changes, style nits, dead or test-only paths outside scope, guard-blocked states, completed migrations, and fixes whose cost exceeds their operational value. Do not defer to the refuter's verdict.

Resolve the candidate and any disagreement, including reachability, the accuracy and verification status of the manifestation, relevant tests and call sites, and remedy proportionality, without adding a second semantic review round or deferring to the prior agents' conclusions.

The finding under judgment is the refutation replacement_finding when the Stage 3 verdict is modify; otherwise it is the original canonical finding. Uphold keeps that finding under judgment, while modify requires a complete same-ID final_finding. All other verdicts must use final_finding null.

Use verdict uphold, modify, reject, or unresolved and record at least one non-empty resolved_points entry explaining the binding result. A rejection must explain why the candidate does not qualify, and unresolved must state the material residual_risk.

Write only the fixed #/$defs/judgment JSON artifact to output_path. Before sending the receipt, execute the packet's validation_command argv exactly. Work read-only, do not delegate, and reveal no finding content in the receipt.
